prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle reported to have backed into a parked sedan. Policy coverage confirmed as in force at time of loss. Initial contact made with the insured, who provided a statement and photos of the damage.

Entry 2: Third-party driver reported neck and knee pain at the scene and was transported to urgent care by family. Claimant has since retained counsel, who has requested that all communication be directed through their office. Letter of representation received and placed in file.

Entry 3: Property damage inspection completed on the claimant's vehicle. Rear bumper, tail light assembly, and trunk lid damage noted. Repair estimate received from the appraiser and under review. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from the property owner; retention period confirmed as limited, preservation request sent.

Entry 4: Medical records received from the claimant's counsel. Diagnosis indicates a knee injury with ligament involvement, and treating physician recommends physical therapy and a follow-up orthopedic evaluation. Bodily injury claim reserve reviewed and adjusted. Supervisor notified of represented status and potential for extended handling time.

Entry 5: Discussed liability position with the insured, who acknowledges fault for the backing incident. Counsel for the claimant contacted by phone and advised that a settlement evaluation will follow receipt of the completed orthopedic report. File diary set for follow-up in thirty days. No further action taken pending records.
